one_liner: Nifty 50 declines 0.70% amid mixed sectoral performance and heightened volatility.

drivers.title: Market Decline
drivers.detail: Nifty 50 fell by 0.70% with no clear catalyst.

drivers.title: Volatility Rises
drivers.detail: India VIX increased by 6.1%, indicating market volatility.

drivers.title: Institutional Flows
drivers.detail: FIIs were net sellers, DIIs net buyers in cash market.

drivers.title: Sectoral Gains
drivers.detail: Nifty Media gained 4.60%, leading sectoral performance.

flows_line: FIIs net sold Rs 1,708.48 Cr; DIIs net bought Rs 3,045.02 Cr.
watch_next: Tomorrow is an expiry day for Nifty 50 weekly options.
lesson_seeds: Nifty 50 declined without a clear catalyst.
Volatility increased significantly, as shown by India VIX.
FIIs and DIIs had opposing cash market flows.
Media sector outperformed with significant gains.
